content:
incident-bot: Pager: Observability ingestion alert for customer AuroraCorp (dedicated VPC). Traces for tenant `aurora-prod` failing to ingest to trace-index. Error rate spike on trace-forwarder, p95 latency elevated. Escalation window: 30m before customer impact ramps. https://alerts.redwood/example/2975312460 :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): acknowledged. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer-visible symptoms?

devon (customer-ops): Aurora says engineers can't see spans for recent requests — they see logs and metrics but traces are blank for request ids they shared. Example trace-id: `9f1a3c2b-aurora-0001`. They escalate because debugging is blocked.

ben (sre): looking at forwarder logs for tenant `aurora-prod` — I see 429s coming back from our trace-index proxy and a few `403: tenant-token-mismatch` entries starting ~10:12 UTC. Could be short-lived token rotation or per-tenant routing rule flapping.

clara (eng-runtime): I can temporarily route aurora-prod to the fallback trace-collector in a different shard while we debug the proxy. Suggest a staged mitigation: 1) open temp route, 2) mint short-lived forwarder token for their pipeline, 3) kick off a small backfill for last 10m of spans.

alice (oncall): agree with staged approach. @clara can you open the route? I'll coordinate with @ben on tokens and @devon for customer comms.

clara (eng-runtime): doing now. Patch command (will run in staging-like prod-runbook):
```
# enable fallback route for aurora-prod (target: collector-fallback-3)
rb-route set --tenant aurora-prod --trace-route collector-fallback-3 --reason "ingest 429s/403s"
```
Running...

ops-deploy-bot: Patch applied to routing table. Route change id: rtb-aurora-20260305-01. Propagation started.

ben (sre): generating a short-lived forwarder token and injecting into the deployment env for aurora-prod. Command:
```
# create ephemeral token (30m expiry)
redwood-cli tokens create --tenant aurora-prod --scope forwarder --ttl 30m --reason "incident mitigation"
```
Token created and rolled to pods via secret sync.

clara (eng-runtime): collector-fallback-3 is receiving traffic. I'm seeing successful 200s for trace batches from the forwarder now. Real-time check: sample trace `9f1a3c2b-aurora-0001` appears in fallback index.

devon (customer-ops): passing update to Aurora support: "We've opened a temporary routing path and are ingesting traces to a fallback collector. You should see recent spans in ~2m. We're backfilling the last 10m. Will follow up when backfill completes." :thumbsup:

alice (oncall): initial mitigation looks effective. Need to confirm: is this isolated to aurora-prod or other tenants on the same shard?

ben (sre): quick scan: two other tenants had transient 429s but no sustained failures or 403s. The token-mismatch errors were only for aurora-prod — likely a replication bug in tenant-token sync.

clara (eng-runtime): starting a lightweight backfill job for aurora-prod now (10m window). Command used:
```
redwood-backfill run --tenant aurora-prod --start "2026-03-05T10:02:00Z" --end "2026-03-05T10:12:00Z" --collector collector-fallback-3
```
Backfill queued (job id: bf-aurora-2975). Estimated time: ~3m.

ops-deploy-bot: Backfill job bf-aurora-2975 started on worker w-09.

clara (eng-runtime): backfill complete. Verified 100% of sample traces surfaced. Trace-index reports ingestion throughput normal for route.

eva (account-sre): I'll send a short status note to Aurora contacts: what happened, mitigation steps, and that this was limited to trace ingest (logs and metrics unaffected). Also note we'll follow up with RCA and a permanent fix ETA.

devon (customer-ops): Aurora support response: "Thanks, we can see traces now. Please confirm cause and when normal routing will be restored."

alice (oncall): next steps: 1) keep fallback route for 30m to monitor, 2) run token-sync check across shard, 3) investigate why token rotated/failed to sync for aurora-prod. @ben and @clara take action items.

ben (sre): initial investigation: a recent deploy to tenant-token-service introduced a race when persisting rotated tokens to the shard cache. Reproducer identified in staging. Rolling back the offending commit to be safe.

clara (eng-runtime): I'll coordinate a rollback to the token-sync microservice with Canary and will not remove fallback route until we confirm stable token sync. Canary rollout target: 10:50 UTC.

ops-deploy-bot: Deployment rollback scheduled: token-sync svc -> rollback to v2.11.3 at 10:47 UTC. Canary window: 5m.

alice (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: monitor aurora-prod traces and shard error rates for 1h after rollback. If any regressions, escalate to eng-runtime immediately.

eva (account-sre): sending customer note now. Suggested message: "We routed your traces to a fallback collector while we resolved an internal token sync issue. Traces are available; we will proactively follow up with a timeline for a permanent fix and an RCA."

devon (customer-ops): Aurora replied: "Appreciate the quick fix, please include us in the RCA."

alice (oncall): incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. I'll update the incident tracker and file a follow-up ticket for a postmortem and runbook update to add an automatic tenant-token verification step during rotations.

ben (sre): filing PR to add tenant-token healthcheck and to add a metric alert for `tenant_token_sync_failures` with a 5m window and 3-occurrence threshold.

clara (eng-runtime): once rollback is stable, I'll remove fallback route and rotate the ephemeral token.

ops-deploy-bot: Rollback completed, canary passed. Route fallback removal scheduled in 20m if healthy.

alice (oncall): last check in — traces stable, no new 403s observed in 15m. Closing pager but leaving incident thread open for RCA notes. Good job all. :tada:

devon (customer-ops): Aurora confirmed they received engineers' access to traces and are unblocked. Requesting postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

alice (oncall): noted. Postmortem owner: ben. ETA for RCA draft: 2026-03-06 EOD. Runbook update owner: clara.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident tags: observability, tenant-isolation, token-sync, fallback-routing.
